group.description: Which newcomers share a turn: a relations component, or every member unknown.

turn.description: Whose turn it is in a group: the lowest hourly key.

reach_1_after_days.description: How long a member's inbox answers without a break before it is in reach 1.

shown.description: When a listing shows a score, and what a self-reported record shows instead.
